Calculation.Text: /* fmIDE.GetMenuItemCall ( pMenuItemName ; pOptionalMenuName ) Returns the ID number of the menu item of the given name. If multiple entries with the same name are found the id of the first entry is returned. Optionally a menu name can be passed to disambiguate. */ Let( [ vMenuItem = fmIDE.GetMenuItemID ( pMenuItemName ; pOptionalMenuName ) ; vMenuItemReference = Case( not IsEmpty( pOptionalMenuName ) ; pOptionalMenuName & " " ) & pMenuItemName ]; Case( not IsEmpty ( vMenuItem ) ; "MBS( \"Menubar.RunMenuCommand\" ; " & vMenuItem & " /* " & vMenuItemReference & " */ ) " ) )
